allow_instructions: Allow ordinary non-destructive MedScale development commands required by the currently eligible canonical Spec Kit unit.
Allow creating and switching normal feature/spec branches, staging files, making focused commits, and pushing normal fast-forward branches to the authenticated MedScale remote.
Allow opening, updating, reviewing, and merging MedScale pull requests when repository-required exact-head gates have passed and the operation is not a force push or destructive history rewrite.
Allow installation and update of public development tools and dependencies only when the owning MedScale spec admits them and the exact version or revision is recorded and locked.
Allow Rust formatting, linting, compilation, unit/integration/property/fuzz tests, benchmarks, SBOM generation, dependency inspection, and supply-chain/security checks within the MedScale workspace.
Allow read-only public-source retrieval, GitHub inspection, documentation lookup, and exact upstream revision verification required by the canonical source acquisition plan.

Allow creation and modification of files inside the MedScale workspace when required by the canonical build queue, including Spec Kit packages, tests, evidence, provenance records, CI configuration, and generated build metadata.
Allow cleanup of build artifacts and temporary files that are generated inside the MedScale workspace and are reproducible from source.
block_instructions: Require approval for any force push, destructive Git history rewrite, branch deletion, tag deletion, remote deletion, or command intended to bypass repository review or CI gates.
Require approval for destructive deletion of source, planning, evidence, provenance, vault, fixture, or user-authored files; never recursively delete outside the MedScale workspace.

Require approval for sudo, administrator elevation, system package removal, operating-system configuration changes, shell-profile changes, SSH configuration changes, or writes outside the MedScale workspace unless they are clearly read-only inspections.
Require approval for accessing, printing, copying, uploading, or transmitting production credentials, private keys, authentication tokens, secrets, or real PHI.
Require approval for any mutation of TheHalfMoon/MESC or any repository other than TheHalfMoon/MedScale.
Require approval for accepting external legal terms, gated model licenses, restricted terminology licenses, App Store agreements, or other human/legal attestations.
Require approval for real production EHR, SMART, NPHIES, healthcare-network, or other external clinical actions; synthetic and local test fixtures remain allowed according to the owning spec.
Require approval for commands that disable, bypass, weaken, or remove MedScale security, privacy, provenance, supply-chain, sandbox, or exact-head qualification gates.
Require approval for arbitrary curl or wget commands that upload local files or include credentials, tokens, PHI, or private repository data.
Require approval for running unreviewed donor install scripts, hooks, binaries, model code, or repository scripts outside the confinement/admission rules in SOURCE_ACQUISITION_AND_COPY_PLAN.md.
